headline: De-Googled GrapheneOS is coming to Motorola’s foldables next year
summary: GrapheneOS, a security-focused Android, plans Motorola support. Official support begins next year with flagships. Foldables and cheaper models will follow.

headline: Humanoid robots smash Usain Bolt’s 100-meter record
summary: Chinese humanoid robots broke Usain Bolt's 100-meter record. Tiangong Ultra ran 9.39 seconds, beating Bolt's 9.58. Honor's Lightning followed at 9.47 seconds.

headline: GTA VI: all the news on Rockstar’s next entry in the Grand Theft Auto series
summary: GTA VI development is ongoing over a decade after GTA V. Rockstar Games has delayed its release twice. The current predicted release is November 19th, 2026.

headline: We&#8217re All Going to the World&#8217s Fair is an intimate coming-of-age horror film
summary: Jane Schoenbrun's new film is making waves. This review revisits their acclaimed debut, "We're All Going to the World's Fair." The film is described as an intimate coming-of-age horror.

headline: Former Rockstar Dev Calls GTA 6 Leaks 'A Nothing Burger,' Insists Hot Coffee Was Much, Much Worse
summary: A former Rockstar developer dismisses recent GTA 6 leaks as minor. He claims the leaks will have little impact on the game's success. He compared them to the "Hot Coffee" scandal, calling that much worse.

headline: Playable Control Resonant and a Dune: Awakening Update Highlight Level Infinite&#8217s Massive gamescom 2026 Plans
summary: Level Infinite is bringing playable demos to Gamescom 2026. Demos include Control Resonant and Dune: Awakening. An exclusive Hunt: Showdown 1896 reveal is also planned.

headline: Pok&#x00e9mon TCG: Premium Collection Sets Are in Stock at Target for MSRP
summary: Target has restocked rare Pokémon TCG premium collection sets. They are available at their original MSRP. This offers one of the best pack-for-pack deals recently seen.

headline: Billie Piper Says She's 'Not the Next Doctor' After That Bizarre Doctor Who Cliffhanger, Asks Fans to 'Chill Out'
summary: Billie Piper addressed her recent Doctor Who cliffhanger. She confirmed she is not becoming the next Doctor. Piper urged fans to "chill out and wait" during the show's hiatus.

headline: Sharing dangerous driving videos is 'truly reprehensible', PM says
summary: The Prime Minister condemned sharing dangerous driving videos. He called the act "truly reprehensible." The government urged social media firms like TikTok to remove such content.

headline: Divorce, smartphones and control - BBC sees how Taliban run Afghanistan
summary: The BBC observed how the Taliban governs Afghanistan. Five years post-return, the group is reshaping the country. The report covers topics like divorce and smartphone use under their control.

headline: Graduate job vacancies drop by almost 50% in a year, survey suggests
summary: A survey indicates a nearly 50% drop in graduate job vacancies. Job site Adzuna reported the lowest numbers since 2016. This suggests a challenging job market for new graduates.

headline: 'It's not Alton Towers' - rows break out over queuing at Wales' highest mountain
summary: Disputes have erupted over queuing at Yr Wyddfa (Snowdon). Some hikers are skipping lines to reach the summit. Commenters emphasized it's not an amusement park.
